title: Ask the path inside holy company
summary: This meets the lonely ache that keeps asking in private circles. The line says the way becomes clearer where the Beloved already dwells: among the true congregation.
lifeApplication: When the mind starts pacing alone for answers, send the message, enter the darbar, or sit near the one who remembers well. Do not keep searching as though the path only appears in isolation.

source.shortMeaning: The path is shown where saintly company gathers around the Lord.
source.lifeApplication: When longing feels lost, move toward the congregation where the Lord is remembered.

evidence.coreClaim: The path is shown where saintly company gathers around the Lord.
evidence.turn: Longing ripens when saintly company shows the way.
